text:
Nina PR: Quick sync 10.30 ET press slot conflict with analyst briefing. Can we compress?
Omar PM: Who's pushing for 10:30?
Jules Marketing: Product demos team asked for 10:30 to match APAC ops. They can do 25m instead of 40m.
Devon Analyst: We need ~20 mins for analyst Qs. 10:30 is ok if the press slot trims.
Nina PR: Okay propose: press demo 10:00-10:25, analyst 10:30-10:50, embargo lift 11:00 ET. Anyone object?
Omar PM: Works for me. Need to confirm final quote wording and that benchmarks table is cleared by eng.
Jules Marketing: I'm preparing the quote. Can we avoid superlatives ("best")? Use precise metrics and use the phrase "consistent production performance."
Devon Analyst: Also include the test workload: 2k concurrent sessions, 2048 tokens seq, 99% cache hit scenario. Analysts asked.
Nina PR: Good call. Attach fact sheet with that workload and p50/p95 numbers. Link: https://drive.example.com/press/factsheet_launch_v3
EmbedBot: Auto-embed preview generated for factsheet_v3.pdf
Omar PM: We're also including the benchmark excerpt. Copy below for sign-off:
```text
p50 = 85ms
p95 = 240ms
avg cost = $0.0023/token
workload = 2k concurrent sessions, 2048 tokens
```
Jules Marketing: slight tweak to last line: "workload: simulated 2k concurrent sessions, 2048 tokens, 99% KV cache hit."
Devon Analyst: That reads better. Approving.
Nina PR: Who's approving the embargo window? We want embargo until 11:00 ET.
Omar PM: Legal OK'd embargo until 11:00. I confirmed.
Jules Marketing: I'll update the press invite and include the factsheet. Also adding a 15-min exclusive analyst Q window after briefing.
Nina PR: Please circulate final quote by 4pm PT. Draft here:
Nina PR: "Redwood Inference helps engineering teams ship LLM features with predictable latency, cost, and reliability at scale."
Omar PM: Approved. Clean.
Devon Analyst: Minor ask: add mention of Dedicated option for enterprise customers in the Q&A doc.
Jules Marketing: Added. Final doc link: https://drive.example.com/press/launch_package_vfinal
Nina PR: I'll update #press-ops when everything is locked. Thanks all :tada:
